item.title: Thinking of entering a comp
item.description: Thanks for the shoutout man! @LGN - you are correct, 5’4” and my stage weight natty was about 140. Based on your pics at 5’9” I’d say 25-30 lbs to lose to get stage ready, but it’s hard to tell without any pics of your back, profile, or legs. Get a great coach for sure, don’t try to figure it out on your own, and have a long, slow and steady prep.
